description: Submit one progressive web app for review. Writes to the moderation queue and emails a receipt to contact_email; a human reviews it before anything is published. Free review takes about 7 days. Requires idempotency_key: replaying the same key returns the first submission instead of creating a duplicate. Returns submission_id, a handle valid for 30 days, after which get_submission_status and create_pro_launch_checkout reject it. Holding the handle authenticates nobody. Submit apps that exist and that you can name; the queue is read by a person.

category.description: One of the catalog categories. If omitted or unknown, the entry is filed for manual categorisation.

contact_email.description: Where the review outcome is sent. Must be an address the submitter can read.

description.description: What the app does, in the submitter's words. 25 words or more, and five or more tags, is what a listing needs to be indexable.

idempotency_key.description: A caller-chosen key. Replaying this tool with the same key returns the first result instead of creating a second entry. MCP defines no idempotency mechanism, so this is an application argument, not a protocol header.

message.description: Anything else the reviewer should know.

name.description: The app's name, as its makers write it.

screenshots.description: URLs of screenshots hosted by the submitter. The directory never re-hosts imagery it does not own.

url.description: The app's public URL. A bare domain is accepted and normalised to https://.

name: submit_pwa
